messages:
jordan: heads-up — opening a small TF + k8s change to split per-model configs from the central 'models-config' ConfigMap into per-namespace configmaps + optional secrets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4123. Plan is to scope by namespace to reduce blast radius. Anyone see immediate gotchas?

marta: @jordan lgtm in principle. main concerns: rollout ordering (deploy sees missing config), and checksum annotation for deployments to trigger pod restart on config update. Did you add checksum/config annotation to StatefulSet/Deployment?

jordan: added annotation on Deployment template: `checksum/configmap-models: sha256(merged-config)`. Terraform will create per-namespace ConfigMap then we apply rollout. Example patch I used locally: ```kubectl patch deployment model-server -n $NS -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"checksum/configmap-models":"abc123"}}}}}'```

marta: note apply order matters — create the ConfigMap first, then update the Deployment so pods pick up the new data. Otherwise pods might start with fallback/old values. Suggested sequence: `kubectl apply -f configmap.yaml && kubectl rollout restart deployment/model-server -n $NS`

kevin: PR looks fine but watch sensitive knobs — are we moving any secrets to k8s Secret? TF should mark provider data as sensitive and avoid printing in logs.

jordan: converting one key (third_party_api_key) to a Secret. For now TF creates the k8s secret resource; long-term we plan ExternalSecrets/SSM sync. Terraform plan shows: + kubernetes_config_map.models-config-<ns>, + kubernetes_secret.model-secrets-<ns>, change to deployment annotation.

sophia: for canary: apply to dev namespace first, run smoke + metrics check (latency, error rate, tail p95) for 30m before promoting. Also add a routing fallback to global models-config if per-namespace config missing — reduces risk during partial rollout.

infra-bot: Build succeeded for PR #4123 — plan: 3 to add, 1 to change. No drift detected.

liz: small ops tip — add a CI preapply grep that fails if manifests still reference the old `models-config` name. I hit a rollback yesterday because an ingress still referenced the global name.

jordan: good call, added a lint step that searches manifests for `models-config` and errors unless allowed. Scheduling a canary for tomorrow 10:00 PST (dev -> staging -> prod). pinging @marta @kevin for final approve before merge.

marta: will do a quick pass tonight. :thumbsup:

kevin: approve from infra side. :white_check_mark:
